items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require every precheck status before accepting the receipt**

A matching receipt containing a valid `head:` but no `- a` through `- i` status lines makes `miss` empty and is accepted at line 35, so a worker can commit a hand-written receipt, supply its hash, and bypass every readiness check. Verification must require exactly one allowed status for every check rather than merely searching for `missing` lines; the closed trust-boundary test never covers an omitted-status receipt.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L77-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/194e0bdef9468eba8b48cbb0904d5f8f6a1fd370/AGENTS.md#L77-L78)

items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve local advisory rows when copying the live record**

When `local-review.sh` returns 3 for a P2/P3, `local-advisory.sh` writes the advisory ledger rows into this seat's acceptance record, but this later copy replaces that file with the canonical checkout's pre-review record. The subsequent front-matter update therefore loses the local-review disposition and can fail the ledger gate or produce incomplete acceptance evidence; copy the live record before running `local-advisory.sh`, or merge its additions instead of overwriting them. The closed integration test only exercises a finding-free local review.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L77-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/194e0bdef9468eba8b48cbb0904d5f8f6a1fd370/AGENTS.md#L77-L78)

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Map review-body finding IDs into sweep dispositions**

When the Codex Bot places a finding in a review body, `pr-feedback.py`/`fill_sweep.py` key that sweep item by `pullrequestreview-<review-id>`, but this parser accepts only numeric IDs and writes only that numeric value to the disposition table. Even if the RESULT marks the review-body finding `fixed:<sha>`, `fill_sweep.py` cannot match the row and the integration chain blocks at `fill-sweep`; support the repository's review-body identifier form and emit the sweep key. The closed integration test covers inline comment IDs only.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L77-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/194e0bdef9468eba8b48cbb0904d5f8f6a1fd370/AGENTS.md#L77-L78)

items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Select the latest worker RESULT that carries threads**

When an integration attempt has already sent either `status=blocked` or `status=ready_for_audit`, that integration RESULT becomes the latest `AGMSG-RESULT` for the task but has no `threads=` field. A retry therefore inspects that line and exits with `no AGMSG-RESULT with threads` instead of reusing the preceding implementing-worker RESULT, so any transient failed step makes the integration seat non-retryable unless the worker redundantly resends its RESULT. Filter for a RESULT containing `threads=` before taking the last match; the closed integration test uses static history and does not exercise the integration RESULT written by the first run.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L77-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/3baa000387059129c7aae6533be0fd49fe82d604/AGENTS.md#L77-L78)

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include review-body findings in the precheck**

When the Codex Bot emits a P0–P3 finding in a review body rather than an inline comment, this query never enumerates it because it reads only `/pulls/<pr>/comments`; `scripts/pr-feedback.py` separately reads `/pulls/<pr>/reviews` for exactly this supported case. Consequently check (g) can report `ok` even though the worker omitted an unresolved review-body P0/P1 from its report, defeating the pre-RESULT gate until the later sweep happens to block integration. The trust-boundary test covers only inline comment IDs, so its declared closed row does not close this input.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L77-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/3baa000387059129c7aae6533be0fd49fe82d604/AGENTS.md#L77-L78)
